body:

* Bump the cargo-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Watfaq/PowerSession-rs/pull/287
* Bump rustls-webpki from 0.103.9 to 0.103.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Watfaq/PowerSession-rs/pull/288

* Bump the cargo-deps group across 1 directory with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Watfaq/PowerSession-rs/pull/296
* Bump the cargo-deps group across 1 directory with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Watfaq/PowerSession-rs/pull/304
* Bump openssl from 0.10.76 to 0.10.80 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Watfaq/PowerSession-rs/pull/303
* Bump rustls-webpki from 0.103.10 to 0.103.13 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Watfaq/PowerSession-rs/pull/295

* Bump log from 0.4.30 to 0.4.32 in the cargo-deps group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Watfaq/PowerSession-rs/pull/309
* Added support for [asciicast v3][1] by @JBenda in https://github.com/Watfaq/PowerSession-rs/pull/310
